issues: SAP/P001g/Defs/Part5.lean:33: hmax requires only attainment and allows tied product-likelihood maximizers. The canonical definitions_needed invokes Definition 5.2.2 and its arg max notation; the book's Glossary of Mathematical Notation, p.285, explicitly assumes uniqueness for that notation. On every positive-size sample from the true support {0,1}, all candidate likelihoods are independent of b, so every valid maximizer has a distinct valid equally maximizing vector. The witness therefore violates the printed estimator's uniqueness condition, rather than refuting the canonical assertion on its domain. See scratch/MixtureCheck.lean and the source citation in REPORT.md.
